_about: intro1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/intro1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

in.land.compress._orig: the touchdown: a deep compression, one open hand flat on the ground, the other arm back for balance, the head up and looking ahead

in.land.hold._orig: held low in the crater: still, the chest rising, the head up

in.land.rise._orig: rising through a half crouch toward the stance, the hand lifting off the ground, the head still up

in.cuff.lift._orig: a small adjustment: one hand rising to the other cuff, the head and eyes staying on the rival

in.roll.lift._orig: the shoulders rolled once: a slow turn of the chest and a tilt of the head, the eyes staying on the rival

in.hold.fall._orig: falling head first: the body one narrow line, the arms tight along the sides, the legs together, the head up to look at where he will land

in.hold.set._orig: the staredown set: upright, the weight even, the arms loose, the chin level, the eyes on the rival

in.hold.tense._orig: the tension: the weight coming forward, the hands rising a little, the chin down a touch, the face set for the close-up
